title.narrative: Low Carbon Agricultural Support Project

description.narrative: The Project will enhance climate smart agriculture development and practices focused on strengthening Low Carbong Agriculture (LCA) policies and institutions; establishing infrastructure support for agri-waste management; and, enhancing LCA technology and development transfer. These will be parts of climate change (CC) mitigation and adaptation measures to reduce green house gas (GHG) emission in 19 provinces of Viet Nam.

description.narrative: Greater uptake of Climate Smart Agricultural Waste Management Practices (CSAWMP)

title.narrative: 13 Dec 2012 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-funded-biogas-plants-tackle-viet-nams-growing-rural-waste-threat
Loan 2968: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 17 Jun 2022

Progress Toward Outcome: By 2020 (from baseline in 2013) in project areas:
(i) At least 70% bio-slurry is converted to organic fertilizer.
Substantially Achieved - Physical audit in 2017-2018 indicated that 58% (equivalent to 83% of target) of treated effluent from biogas plants was applied as fertilizer.
(ii) At least 80% energy produced by BVCs is utilized.
Substantially Achieved - Utilization of SBP gas was greater and approached 90% as the scale of gas production better matched individual household. Utilization of digester gas was limited for MSP and LSP compared with volumes of gas produced. requirements.
(iii) Daily workload of women and children is reduced by 1.8-2 hours, on average.
Achieved - Baseline survey indicated biogas digesters save an average of 0.76 hour for cooking; 0.84 hour for preparing feed; 0.66 hour for feeding livestock and 0.59 hour for cleaning facilities. On a daily basis, total working time on cooking and taking care of livestock is reduced by 2.85 hours.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Nov 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45406/45406-001-apfs-en_11.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | May 2021: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/45406/45406-001-smr-en_3.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: Output 1:
(i) 65,000 SBPs, 40 MBPs, and 2 LBPs and associated value chain infrastructure constructed and operating by June 2019.
Achieved - 62,248 SBPs, 83 MBPs, and 2 LBPs were installed/constructed under the project - but by June 2020.
At least 5% of total SBPs will be constructed for ethnic minorities in project provinces.
Achieved - 6,581 units were built in ethnic minority households comprising 10.6% of SBP installations.
(ii) ICMD funds are fully channeled into at least 65,042 accounts of beneficiaries by June 2019.
Achieved - 95.8% of the installed digesters received incentive payments into joint bank accounts of beneficiaries.
(iii) 65,000 SBP operators, 500 masons, 500 technicians, 28 engineers, and 10 contractors trained by June 2019.
Achieved - 117,447 SBP biogas operators were trained as were 346 masons, 1,286 technicians, 28 engineers and 18 contractors.
At least 50% of trainees on biogas use will be women; 7% of trainees on SBP construction, and 20% of those trained on biogas management and technical issues will be women.
Achieved - Women represented 52.7% of biogas use trainees, 7% of construction trainees, 23.4% of technician trainees, and engineer trainees were 14.3% women.
(iv) Single national biogas plant database managed effectively by 2017, including registration in both husband's and wife's names.
Not Achieved - 47,640 biogas plants were recorded in the LCASP database (not a national database) by project completion yet only 14,178 of those qualified for participation in an international carbon credit scheme. Majority of recorded Biogas Plants did not register in both husband's and wife's names.
Output 2:
(i) 50% of credit lines will be under joint accounts and/or on behalf of women by June 2019.
Achieved - of the 457 sub-loans extended by FIs, 100% were issued in joint names.
(ii) At least 15,000 households raising livestock have accessed credits for BVC and other climate-smart agriculture waste management investments from the participating FIs by June 2019.
Not Achieved - A total of 457 household sub-loans were extended by FIs in five provinces prior to the cancellation of the credit facility in 2018.
Output 3:
(i) CSAWMP research strategy developed and adaptive research on at least six CSAWMP topics conducted by June 2019. At least two research topics will include gender issues.
Partially Achieved - Consultants were engaged to propose a research strategy for government and propose adaptive research identifying seven research topics. These were ratified by MARD in 2020 as appropriate technologies. Seven research packages were awarded, four of which achieved intended research targets (Nos. 27, 29, and 42). The remaining three packages (Nos. 25, 26, 28 and 43) failed to deliver expected outputs. Two research topics are related to gender issues.
(ii) At least seven CSAWMP models are successfully demonstrated and disseminated in 10 participating provinces by June 2019.
Achieved - Twelve demonstration packages (including five replication packages) were undertaken on 189 households of the 10 provinces.
(iii) At least 7,000 farmers, 700 extension staff, and 200 researchers trained on CSAWMPs by June 2019. At least 50% of farmers and 30% of extension staff trained are women.
Achieved - The project provided CSAWMP training to 26,538 farmers - (50.5% being women) and 1,739 extension workers (33.2% being women).
Output 4:
(i) A CPMU and 10 PPMUs established and operational with adequately skilled staff and facilities in MARD by first quarter of 2013.
Achieved - A CPMU and 10 PPMUs established in the second quarter of 2013.
At least 30% of staff are women and a gender focal point will be appointed by 2014.
Achieved - As of June 2020, 56 of 129 staff were women (43.41%). Gender focal points in CPMU and PPMUs were appointed in July 2016.
(ii) PPMS with sex-disaggregated and ethnicity data collected and reported operating effectively in 10 provinces by 2015.
Achieved - The PPMS with sex-disaggregated data and ethnicity data collected and reported to ADB in quarterly progress reports effectively by 2015.
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/45406-001/main#project-tenders
